name: CVW Sustainable Royalties Inc.
summary: CVW CleanTech Inc., renamed from Titanium Corporation Inc. in 2022 and based in Calgary, Canada, develops technology to recover bitumen and heavy minerals in Canada. Its proprietary Value from Waste technology is designed to pull water, minerals, solvents and bitumen out of oil sands tailings, and the firm also has interests in mining projects in the oil sands.
